title: Droga do C1
audience: Adults (and older teenagers). Mature general-interest themes: work, money, society, media, science, psychology, business. No explicit content.
vocabGuide: Genuinely B2 or C1 on the CEFR scale (English Vocabulary Profile / Cambridge Dictionary labels): high-utility items an educated native speaker uses in conversation, films, podcasts and newspapers today: precise adjectives and verbs, phrasal verbs, strong collocations, idioms in current use, false friends for Polish speakers. No A1-B1 basics, no C2 rarities, nothing literary, dated or technical.
